invariants.rationale: partitionPath is used to create a new BucketInfo, so it should not be null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
fileIdHint is used as a key in updateLocationToBucket and as an argument to BucketInfo, so it must be non-null for normal operation.
partitionPath represents a path and is likely expected to be non-empty.
fileIdHint is used as a key/id hint and likely expected to be non-empty.
getSmallFiles(partitionPath) should return a List, confirming the API contract.
